Each booking has a start_day string in YYYY-MM-DD format. Return a new list of all active bookings starting on day, in stored order.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.

marking_points.criterion: Returns complete result,including empty list when no match.

def bookings_on(self, day):
    result = []
    for i in range(self.used):
        booking = self.bookings[i]
        if booking.start_day == day:
            result.append(booking)
    return result
